items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We also have information based on the letter that I received from Johnson McRee, that you made one more title...

ctx.x:
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

That's right. We also have information based on the letter that I received from Johnson McRee, that you made one more title, this being committed to record from the December 6, 1970 Manassas jazz festival. This is by the same group that performed 'Georgia On My Mind' on the album entitled 'Queen of Song,' which we discussed earlier. There's another Fat Cat album which I don't have a title, but the number is FCJ126, and a performance of The 'St. Louis Blues.' Not the one we discussed earlier, but a different one…
Well I think that this is an indication that I've run out on material for Fat Cat records since we're down to 'St. Louis Blues' -- one song.
